scope: Independent synthetic check, not a general robustness benchmark
method: Encoded-frame ECC Euclidean registration against each clip first frame; remove linear trend, compute translation/rotation RMS. Different estimator from runtime LK/RANSAC.
synthetic_input: 60 frames, 400x240,30fps, known textured rigid scene with sinusoidal translation/rotation and small linear drift

static_mask.source: Synthetic color-separated ellipse with known pixel ground truth
static_mask.note: Single easy segmentation case; does not establish complex hair, glass or video performance

real_input_motion_diagnosis.note: A valid fit is not semantic proof of background identity

regression.scope: Eight CV preparation tests plus six prior geometry/time mapping tests
